reference_scope: 20 selected printed occurrences; ordered visual left-to-right drawn units, including editorial auxiliaries.

source.title: Corpus of Texts in the Indus Script
source.transformations: Unmarked rendered context crops compared visually with the published numerical chart.

blinding.source_ocr_exposure: The first locator read displayed source-PDF OCR witnesses. Number-like strings were noticed for43 and51, nonmatching or fragmented strings for42,44 and52. Later locator reads selected coordinates only, then used selection-source-only.json. Printed IDs were read visually from the crops. See ANNOTATOR-C.md.

conventions.chart_labels: Stable Finnish lower codes, not Wells IDs.
conventions.chart_coordinates: One-based PDF page; zero-based chart column and row.
conventions.classification_literal: Exactly five character positions, retaining spaces.
conventions.drawn_unit_count: Chart-sized glyph or auxiliary drawings; underlines are attributes and do not add units.
conventions.original_sign_count: Null throughout because this reference records plotted units, without reconstructing original physical inscription extent.
conventions.shape_only_candidate_codes: For underlined units this records the corresponding plain shape code; for other units it retains the visually selected chart code. It does not enumerate every same-rank variant.
conventions.qualitative_confidence: Visual confidence labels, without probability calibration.
conventions.crop_correct: Correctness of the declared target glyph_pdf_box; wider supplied context intentionally includes neighbours.
conventions.review_status: AI visual annotation; no expert gold-standard claim.
